WITH status_rates AS (
  SELECT
    si.healtheval AS health_status,
    SUM(s.scancount) AS total_scans,
    SUM(s.gbsize) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.spanmin), 0) AS gb_per_minute
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
  WHERE s.gbsize IS NOT NULL
    AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY si.healtheval
),
status_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute) AS average_gb_per_minute
  FROM status_rates
)
SELECT
  sr.health_status,
  sr.total_scans,
  sr.gb_per_minute,
  sr.gb_per_minute - sa.average_gb_per_minute AS above_average
FROM status_rates AS sr
CROSS JOIN status_average AS sa
WHERE sa.average_gb_per_minute IS NOT NULL
  AND sr.gb_per_minute > sa.average_gb_per_minute;
